items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And the people who were there, Dr. Ogawa and Mr. Namacoti and gee I can’t recall at the moment, it was like a life beyond life.

ctx.x: He looked too fabulous with his little outfit that he had on, he had beige, and that was my favorite color on him, and he loved blue. And so I just said well I can’t win this one, and I have to let it go, and so we went. And it was very difficult because he got ill on the plane and we had to sit down in Hawaii and stay there for three days while he got better, and then we went to there and they were kind enough to have a medical doctor in the suite next to us, who was on call 24 hours, stayed with us and saw that…

Well gee, that’s, and you’ve had, since Alfred passed, you have gotten into another dimension of entertainment with your Cable Access work, and I wanted to congratulate you on your award, from the PACE organization.
